title: Death ban+
description: This makes it so players that die are banned upon death. You can bring them back by reviving them.
body:
This is datapack that Hikehy and I made.

https://youtu.be/7CbDh5EOxV4?si=zyrm0ikO5id0aHcD

# What does it do?
- Bans players on dying
- Adds a revive function to bring them back
- Coustomizable(Comming Soon)

# How do I revive a player?
- When a player dies they will drop their head. You can use that head by dropping it on a beacon to revive them

# How do a reset/delete vaules?
- Use /function deathban:settings/reset (Note: You will have to manually unban players that have died)
